obligations.statement: image_gap runs only when finite(incoming) and incoming >= 0 and incoming <= 64; otherwise failure invalid_argument, unchanged.
Unless finite(incoming) and incoming >= 0 and incoming <= 64, image_gap changes nothing observable.
text_line_spacing runs only when finite(incoming) and 4 * incoming >= 3 and incoming <= 3; otherwise failure invalid_argument, unchanged.
Unless finite(incoming) and 4 * incoming >= 3 and incoming <= 3, text_line_spacing changes nothing observable.
